title: Genetic analyses on the differentiation of the Himalayan marmot in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iyxcfxn

steps.title: Store tissue and extract DNA
steps.instruction: Store tissue samples in 95% ethanol immediately after collection. Extract total genomic DNA using the Ezup Column Animal Genomic DNA Purification Kit (Sangon Biotech) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Amplify mitochondrial cyt b and flanking regions
steps.instruction: Prepare a 40 µL PCR containing 1 µL genomic DNA (~60 ng), 5.0 µL 10×PCR buffer (with Mg²⁺), 2.5 µL dNTPs (2.5 mM), 1 µL forward primer CY‑F (5’‑ATCCTAAGCCTCCGTAAATAGGA‑3’, 10 µM) and 1 µL reverse primer CY‑R (5’‑CAGGGAATAGTT TAAGTAAGAAATGTCA‑3’, 10 µM), 0.5 µL Taq DNA polymerase (5 U/µL, 2.5 U total), and 29 µL sterile double‑distilled water. Run the PCR: 95 °C 5 min; 30 cycles of 95 °C 45 s, 57 °C 45 s, 72 °C 1 min 45 s; final extension 72 °C 10 min. Send the amplified products for bidirectional sequencing to Shanghai Sangon Biological Engineering Technology & Services Co., Ltd.

steps.title: Amplify microsatellite loci
steps.instruction: For each of the 11 loci (B, D, E, G, H, I, J, M, R, T, W) set up a 20 µL PCR with 0.5 µL genomic DNA (~30 ng), 2 µL 10×PCR buffer (with Mg²⁺), 1 µL dNTPs (2.5 mM), 0.4 µL each fluorescently‑labelled primer (10 µM), 0.2 µL Taq DNA polymerase (5 U/µL, 1 U total), and 15.5 µL sterile double‑distilled water. Thermocycle: 95 °C 4 min; 40 cycles of 95 °C 45 s, annealing at the locus‑specific Tm (as listed) 25 s, 72 °C 20 s; final extension 72 °C 2 min. Submit the fluorescent fragments for fragment analysis to Shanghai Sangon Biological Engineering Technology & Services Co., Ltd.

steps.title: Select substitution model for phylogeny
steps.instruction: Use Jmodeltest v2.1.6 with the Akaike Information Criterion to determine the best‑fit DNA substitution model for the aligned cyt b dataset.

steps.title: Construct maximum‑likelihood tree
steps.instruction: Run PhyML v3.0 from the command line with the following options: phyml -i myfile.phy -d nt -n 1 -b 1000 --run_id TIM2+G -m 010232 -f m -v e -c 4 --no_memory_check -o tlr -s BEST. Perform 1000 bootstrap replicates to obtain branch support values.

steps.title: Perform Bayesian phylogenetic inference
steps.instruction: Execute MrBayes v3.2.3 with two simultaneous MCMC runs for 10 000 000 generations, sampling every 100 generations. Discard the first 25 % of sampled trees as burn‑in, then generate a consensus tree and calculate Bayesian posterior probabilities.

steps.title: Visualize trees and add reference sequences
steps.instruction: Open the resulting trees in FigTree v1.4.3. Add two cyt b reference sequences (M. h. himalayana, Accession No. JX069958; M. h. robusta, Accession No. AF143928) and the outgroup M. sibirica (Accession No. AF143937) to the dataset, then re‑visualize the trees.

steps.title: Build median‑joining haplotype network
steps.instruction: Use NETWORK v5.0 to compute a median‑joining haplotype network based on the maximum‑parsimony criterion. Remove ambiguous connections as described by Posada & Crandall (2001) to retain only definite connections.

steps.title: Estimate divergence times with BEAST
steps.instruction: Prepare a BEAST v1.8.3 XML employing a strict molecular clock, constant‑size coalescent prior, and HKY+I substitution model. Set three calibrations: (i) normal prior mean 10.3 Mya, SD 0.9 Mya for the MRCA of marmots and the sister clade (Callospermophilus lateralis, C. saturatus, Otospermophilus beecheyi) based on the Marmota minor fossil; (ii) normal prior mean 6.0 Mya, SD 0.8 Mya for the MRCA of subgenera Petromarmota and Marmota; (iii) normal prior mean 4.9 Mya, SD 0.6 Mya for the MRCA of subgenus Marmota. Include cyt b sequences of 16 related species with the following accession numbers: M. camtschatica (AF100715), M. baibacina (AF143915), M. kastschenkoi (AF143914), M. bobak (AF143917), M. menzbieri (AF143931), M. caudata (AF143925), M. marmota (AF143929), M. broweri (AF143919), M. monax (AF143934), M. olympus (JF313271), M. vancouverensis (AF143939), M. caligata (AF143920), M. flaviventris (AF143927), C. lateralis (AF157887), C. saturatus (AF157917), O. beecheyi (AF157919). Run the MCMC for 10 000 000 generations, sampling every 1000 generations; discard the first 10 % of samples as burn‑in. Assess convergence and effective sample sizes with TRACER v1.6, summarize the maximum clade credibility tree with TreeAnnotator v1.8.3, and display node ages with 95 % highest posterior density intervals in FigTree v1.4.3.

steps.title: Infer microsatellite genetic structure
steps.instruction: Run Structure v2.3 on the microsatellite dataset using the admixture model with correlated allele frequencies. For each K value from 1 to 20 perform five independent runs, each with 500 000 MCMC steps after a burn‑in of 50 000 steps. Determine the optimal K with Structure Harvester using the ΔK statistic. Align cluster membership coefficients across runs with CLUMPP v1.1.2 and generate individual assignment plots with DISTRUCT v1.1.
